reviews.title: Required subscription for the most basic functions
reviews.text: I thought it only required a subscription to do things like add custom symptoms or whatever. That’s certainly what they imply. But no, you need a subscription to even add events to the diary. Completely unusable without some sort of subscription

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: App crashes when trying to create an account

reviews.title: Not so ‘free’ when subscription is required.
reviews.text: won’t let you start a ‘free’ trial without setting up a subscription. Would much rather have a one-time purchase cost than recurring fee.

reviews.title: Require requires a paid subscription
reviews.text: This app does not show that there are an app purchase options. However, you’re required to sign up for a monthly subscription.

reviews.title: Only paid option available.
reviews.text: This app only operates long term on a paid subscription. No long term free option available.

reviews.title: Username request broken
reviews.text: When creating a username, and the message states it's available then selecting the request. It clears the name and places a different one and it just loops over and over. The request button doesn't create a username. So the app doesn't work.

reviews.title: Couldn't get past the  username selection
reviews.text: I tried picking several different anonymous usernames that the app said we're avaliable and then hitting  "request" but if just kept returning suggestions for new usernames.i tried agreeing to the one they suggested and it still kept offering me new choices. Forget it. Deleted app.
